messages:
Lina: Midnight thought — looking for the weirdest under-2hr movie you'd recommend for a 1am watch. Bonus: pair it with a 20-min song or a 3-chapter short book to read before credits. Throw weird recs at me.

Joel: Ooh: 'The Lobster' if you haven't seen it. Pair with a quiet ambient piece like 'Lake by the Ocean' — short, weirdly melancholic. :thinking:

Priya: For <2hr and weird: 'Timecrimes' — tense and tight. Pair w/ a short eerie radio piece or a 20-min drone track. :grin:

Matt: If we can go surreal: 'Paprika' (anime, trippy visuals), and 20-min song = live 'The Host of Seraphim' — heavy, haunting.

Anna: Completely different: 'Coherence' + read 3 chapters of Ted Chiang's 'The Truth of Fact, the Truth of Feeling' (shortish, mind-bendy). :book:

Lina: loving these. Low-key poll: drop :one: for drama, :two: for anime, :three: for sci-fi mindbender. I'll tally.

Joel: :one: (if enough people pick drama I'll binge tonight)

Priya: :three: (coherence vibes)

Matt: :two: :rocket:

Anna: :three: I already owned a projector so biased :stuck_out_tongue: 

spotify-bot: Playlist posted — https://open.spotify.com/playlist/0example — 'Nightcap Oddities' (10 tracks, 18m). Includes a Host of Seraphim cover, a couple of ambient interludes, and one long live cut.

Joel: also throwing 'I Stand Alone' — 12m rare live cut, pairs weirdly well.

Lina: ok tally so far: 1 x :one:, 2 x :two:, 2 x :three:. Thanks y'all. Anyone got a good short weird documentary rec?

Priya: 'Samsara' — visual, almost no dialogue, 90m, so fits the vibe and is stunning.

Matt: Also 'American Movie' if you want laugh-then-cringe weirdness.

Anna: If you want text: try Jorge Luis Borges short story 'The Library of Babel' — one quick read, perfect cleanse before sleep.

Lina: perfect. I'll assemble a mini-watchlist + playlist and drop it here after dinner. :thumbsup:

Joel: Can't wait. Enjoy!
